'''Teiki''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mining/Legends|miner]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Teiki was present when he was the first to witness a huge army of [[Battle droid/Legends|Battle droids]] approaching the village and was killed during the [[Battle of Lanteeb|attack]].
